title: Mega Pack by BaldiGuy
description: This resource pack adds a lot of chaotic sounds and textures.
body:
# WARNING!
This resource pack includes copyright material and a bit of guns, NOT recommended for children.

## Credits for the textures and sounds:
-**George Fan**: Made Plants VS Zombies.
-**mystman12**: Creator of Baldi's Basics.
-**The fartering new**: Creator of Roblox Grace.

Don't know how to play the custom sounds? Do this command in minecraft:
/playsound custom.
then you will see alot of sound options there!

**How to get a custom textured item:**
/give @p stick[custom_model_data={floats:[90]}]
The "90" can be ANY number, it's just an example, by the way it doesn't go past 161 and some textures might still be broken.

**Example custom sound:**
/playsound custom.otherb.countdown player @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1
